description: Close the loop after an invoice is issued: stamp the tracked hours that went on it with the invoice number, so report and invoice_summary stop offering them and the same hours are never billed twice.

billed_at.description: ISO timestamp of the stamp, defaults to now

from.description: ISO date/time start of the billed period, used with project

ids.description: Exact entry ids, normally the entry_ids invoice_summary returned. Pass either ids or project plus from and to. Entries already billed are left alone and listed back to you.

invoice_number.description: The invoice these hours were put on, e.g. INV-2026-0001

project.description: Project or client, used with from and to instead of ids; every billable entry in that range is stamped.

to.description: ISO date/time end of the billed period, used with project

name: entry_mark_billed
title: Mark time entries as billed
